name: STC-08XGE.docx
path: Realtek Based Commercial Switch/Commercial Ethernet Switch/STC-08XGE.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Introduction
It adopts a storage and forwarding mechanism, and internally integrates a high capacity cache to ensure that all ports can achieve 10G non-blocking line speed forwarding for more emergency situations
With a durable and high strength fan steel shell design, the efficient heat dissipation ensures stable operation
This switch has 8*10 Gigabit RJ45 ports enjoying
seamless connection for 10/100/1000/2500M/5G/10G Ethernet
easy to manage and maintain
It can be widely used in security network video surveillance, hotel, campus, small and medium-sized enterprise network engineering and other occasions
Key Features
8*10G Ethernet ports
Support IEEE 802.3, IEEE 802.3u, IEEE 802.3ab, IEEE 802.3 bz, IEEE 802.3 ae, IEEE 802.3. x, IEEE 802.3az
Ethernet ports support 100/1000M/2500M/5G/10G self-adaptive
Support port automatic MDI/MDIX
Panel indicators monitor operating conditions and assist in fault analysis
Flow control mode, IEEE802.3x standard for full duplex, and back pressure standard for half duplex
Support surge protection: common mode 6KV; ESD Air 8KV, contact 6KV
Specification
Product Name	8 Port 10G Ethernet Switch
Port	8x100/1000M/2.5G/5G/10G UTP RJ45(Support MDI/MDIX, auto-sensing)
Switching Capacity	160Gbps
Throughput	119.04Mpps
RAM	128MByte
Flash Memory	16MByte
Memory Cache	12MBit
MAC Address	16K
Jumbo Frame	12Kbytes
Transfer Mode	Store and forward
MTBF	100000 hours
Network Protocol	IEEE802.3(Ethernet) / IEEE802.3u(Fast Ethernet) / IEEE 802.3ab(Gigabit Ethernet) / IEEE 802.3az(Efficient and energy-saving Ethernet) / IEEE 802.3ae(10G Ethernet) / IEEE802.3x(Flow control) / IEEE802.3 bz(2.5G/5G Ethernet standard)
Industry Standard	EMI: FCC Part 15, CISPR(EN55032)class A / EMS: EN61000-4-2(ESD) / EN61000-4-5(Surge)
Network Medium	10Base-T: Cat3, 4, 5 or above UTP(≤100m) / 100Base-TX: Cat5 or above UTP(≤100m) / 1000Base-TX: Cat5 or above UTP(≤100m)
Certification	CE/FCC/RoHS
Working Environment	Working Temperature: -10℃~50℃ / Storage Temperature: -40℃~70℃ / Working Humidity: 10%~90%, non-condensing / Storage Temperature: 5%~95%, non-condensing
Input Voltage	AC100-240V, Single Power Input / Internal DC12V8A Converter
Power Consumption	＜38.6W
LED Indicators	PWR(Power indicator) / On: power on
Off: no power / Port LED light (green) / On: 5G/10G link connection is normal / Flashing: Data transmission is normal / Off:  Link not working / Port LED (yellow) / On: 100/1000M link connection is normal / Flashing: Data transmission is normal / Off: Link not working
Application
IP-based Communication
Vehicle Network Solution
Dimension
Remark

Packing Information
1pc switch(neutral device)
1pc power cable(standards vary across countries)
1pc user manual(including QIG information)
1pair mounting brackets(rack mountable)
Please know that there is NOT a warranty card in the packing box
A “Warranty Certificate” will be issued to indicate the order information and warranty coverage
Shipping box information(Below information is approximately accurate)
Product size: 320*207*44.5mm
Inner box size: 370*290*85mm
Product weight: 1.72Kg
Packing weight: 2.12Kg
Master box size: 445*310*390mm
Packing quantity: 5Pcs
Packing weight: 11.6Kg
Remark
Accessories(Network cable etc.)are NOT included in the packing box
Power cable is included in BOTH the packing box AND unit pricing
